description_en: Adds a user to the face database
description_zh: 调用该接口向人脸底库添加一个用户
kebab_example: aliyun linkvisual add-face-user --isolation-id ZheJiangHZ --face-pic-url https://example.com/test.jpeg --custom-user-id 1234567890 --name Tony --params key1_:_value1_,_key2_:_value2 --api-version 2018-01-20 --region cn-hangzhou
name: AddFaceUser

parameters.help_en:
The business isolation ID, which is used for data isolation between different business applications under the same Alibaba Cloud account. The value can contain uppercase and lowercase letters and digits.

For example, if you have face recognition services in both Region A and Region B, you can set different business isolation IDs to distinguish between the face recognition services in Region A and Region B.

><notice>
Save the business isolation ID properly for use when calling other operations in this business isolation zone.
></notice>
parameters.help_zh:
业务隔离ID，用于同一个阿里云账号下不同业务应用之间的数据隔离，支持英文大小写字母、数字。

例如，您在A地区和B地区，均有人脸识别业务，那么可设置不同的业务隔离ID，区分A、B地区的人脸识别业务。

><notice>
请妥善保存业务隔离ID值，以便后续调用此业务隔离区其它接口时使用。
></notice>
parameters.name: isolation_id

parameters.help_en: The URL download address of the user's face image. Only images in JPEG and JPG formats are supported, and the image URL cannot contain Chinese characters
parameters.help_zh: 用户的人脸图片URL下载地址，目前仅支持JPEG和JPG格式的图片，且图片URL不能包含中文
parameters.name: face_pic_url

parameters.help_en:
The user identity ID. The value can contain uppercase letters and digits.

Set this to the user's ID card number or student ID
parameters.help_zh:
用户身份识别ID，支持英文大写字母和数字。

建议您设置为该用户的身份证号、学号等
parameters.name: custom_user_id

parameters.help_en: The username. The value can contain Chinese characters, uppercase and lowercase letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-), and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh: 用户名。支持中文、英文字母大小写、数字、下划线（_）和短划线（-），长度不超过64个字符
parameters.name: name
